title: Input and output examples
responsibility: Shows documented uses beside expected outcomes, or recorded calls beside observed results.

inputs.name: EntityCases.document
inputs.description: Optional parsed test result. Used when no documented examples are supplied.

inputs.name: EntityCases.unit
inputs.description: Optional unit identifier limiting direct invocation rows to that function.

inputs.name: EntityCases.callable
inputs.description: Optional flag, true by default. Controls wording distinguishing observed end-to-end behavior from a direct function call; false is suitable for noncallable entities.

inputs.name: EntityCases.examples
inputs.description: Documented uses with input and one expected output or error. These are never recorded test results.

outputs.name: EntityCases
outputs.description: Readable input and output rows. Authored examples show expected outcomes; test records show observed outcomes. Full values remain available in a disclosure.
